subject: Auditing and Ethics
question_text:
6. 
CA Rocky is a recently qualified Chartered Accountant. He is appointed 
as an auditor of Sky Ltd. for the current Financial Year 2023-24.  
CA Rocky is of the view that he shall record all the matters related to 
audit i.e., audit procedures to be performed, audit evidence obtained

and conclusions reached. Thus, he maintained a file and recorded each 
and every finding during the audit. His audit file, also includes audit 
programmes, 
notes 
reflecting 
preliminary 
thinking, 
letters 
of 
confirmation, e-mails concerning significant matters, etc. State which of 
the following need not be included in the audit documentation? 
(a) 
Audit programmes. 
(b) 
E-mails concerning significant matters. 
(c) 
Letters of confirmation. 
(d) 
Notes reflecting preliminary thinking.
